title: Transfer - Urban Underpass Closure Watch
goal: Use 5-minute underpass water-depth CSVs plus per-site closure thresholds from JSON, aggregate to daily maxima, and write `/root/output/underpass_closure_days.csv` listing only underpasses with at least one closure-risk day, their blocked-day counts, and worst closure category reached.
skillBenefitRationale: The domain shifts from river gauges to transportation assets, but the essential work is still flood detection: threshold comparison on water levels, daily aggregation, and severity classification. No additional shipped skill is needed beyond the existing flood-detection guidance.
